map.12 分制，≥85%(≥10分)优秀、≥65%(≥8分)良好、≥40%(≥5分): On a 12-point scale, 85% or above (10 or more points) is excellent, 65% or above (8 or more) good, 40% or above (5 or more) average, and below 40% insufficient. Those scoring below have a high risk of sports injury and should progress gradually from basic core training, consulting a rehabilitation therapist if needed.

map.平板支撑测前侧核心抗伸展；侧平板测侧链（腹斜肌/腰方肌）稳定；死虫测抗旋转与四肢: The front plank tests anterior core anti-extension; the side plank tests lateral chain (obliques, quadratus lumborum) stability; the dead bug tests anti-rotation and limb coordination; Bird Dog tests hip and shoulder stability with the spine neutral. The four complement each other, so a low score on one does not mean the whole is poor.
map.康复人群跟踪核心功能恢复进度，定期复测对比总分与等级变化，量化康复效果。: Track the recovery of core function in a rehabilitation population, re-testing regularly to compare total score and grade changes and quantify the effect of rehabilitation.
map.训练前/后自测核心稳定性：平板支撑、侧平板、死虫、Bird Dog 四项打分，得: Self-test core stability before and after training: score the front plank, side plank, dead bug and Bird Dog to get a 12-point total and a grade.
map.评分规则：平板支撑≥120s=3、≥60s=2、≥30s=1、否则0；侧平板≥9:
Scoring rules: front plank >= 120 s = 3, >= 60 s = 2, >= 30 s = 1, otherwise 0; side plank >= 90 s = 3, >= 45 s = 2, >= 20 s = 1, otherwise 0; dead bug and Bird Dog are scored 0-3 on completion quality.
